entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Skipped test: ValidateCSharpTemplateProjects blazor and blazorwasm #80263
  • Intellisense C# nameof() suggestions don't work inside object initializer #80258
    Backlog
  • Cannot apply user-defined conditional logical operators on built-in types #80257
  • Assert fails in `NullableWalker.AsMemberOfType` #80255
  • Assert failing in LocalRewriter.CollectAndVisitConcatArguments #80254
    Next

Closed

  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.BannedApiAnalyzers v4.14.0 #80232
  • Provide a way for specific DiagnosticAnalyzers to get specific AnalyzerOptions when running analyzers #80143
    18.0
  • Typed foreach over collection expression yields CS9176 #80260
  • Linq `Reverse()` calls now map to `MemoryExtensions.Reverse()` #80259
  • The behavior of an extension member block with two generic arguments is inconsistent. #80253
  • CLS compliance assert fails on extension blocks #80250
    Next
  • [Extensions] CS0570 when consuming static extension method from external assembly #80014
    Next

PullRequests

Created

  • Move extensions to where they are actually called #80268
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Add friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #80267
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Use implicit object creation expressions #80266
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix our registration for our TempPE compilers #80265
    Area-IDE
  • Rename SuggestedAction types. #80264
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Restore SemanticModel behavior for invocations of not invocable targets #80262
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix 'GetRefEscape' for invocation using old rules #80261
    Area-Compilers
  • Do not make assumptions about content of erroneous BoundCall node based on value of InvokedAsExtensionMethod property #80256
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Address missed feedback on SyntaxGenerator #80249
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Remove CompilationPair abstraction in diagnostic analyzer subsystem. #80086
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • Add api to allow customizing options per DiagnosticAnalyzer #80200
    Needs API Review, Next
  • Further cleanup of the code action api (8) #80252
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Handle extension blocks in CLS compliance checker #80251
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Simplify the CodeFix type #80236
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Remove CompilationPair abstraction in diagnostic analyzer subsystem #80141
    Area-Analyzers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Use dotnet run file for generating compiler code #80248
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove CS1998 warning entirely and remove dependent C# code fix providers #80144
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Better error recovery for incomplete local declarations #79115
    Area-Compilers
  • WIP: Initial work to support renaming files to match types inside in bulk #80246
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Only publish to the VS feed for our official build #80009
    Area-Infrastructure
